subtopic: Annuity Exchanges and Conflicts of Interest
source_evidence: Some financial professionals may have a financial incentive to offer you a new annuity in place of the one you own.
question: Why should you carefully evaluate an annuity exchange suggested by a financial professional?
answer: The professional may have a financial incentive to recommend a new annuity. Before exchanging, compare the old and new contracts’ features, fees, rates, and risks. An exchange may also involve a surrender charge on the old contract and a new surrender-charge period on the replacement contract.
